scenarios.label: Scenarios as declared
scenarios.note: final run status matched each manifest's expected_outcome: pass = approved at iteration 1, heal = approved after repair, escalate = escalated at the 3-iteration budget

first_pass_rate.label: First-pass rate
first_pass_rate.note: runs whose iteration-1 harness report passed (acme-treasury); 4 scenarios inject a defect on purpose

healed_rate.label: Healed
healed_rate.note: heal scenarios repaired and approved within 3 iterations (blue-harbour-fx, kestrel-payments, northwind-custody, orion-prime)

adversarial_rejected.label: Adversarial rejected
adversarial_rejected.note: hand-written almost-right artifacts whose harness report failed on every check their expect.json says must fail

mean_iterations.label: Mean iterations
mean_iterations.note: generate/evaluate iterations per run, 6 runs, budget 3

checkpoints.label: Checkpoints
checkpoints.note: LangGraph checkpoints across 6 runs via service.history, counting every step including each run's step -1 input checkpoint

bars.title: Defects caught by check (40 error findings across 12 iteration reports and 5 adversarial reports)

rows.label: MCP tool calls made
rows.value: 18 over an in-memory MCP session (list_samples, peek_sample, profile_sample), recorded in each IngestionPlan.tool_calls

rows.label: Artifacts published
rows.value: 5 clients under deploy/ (acme-treasury, blue-harbour-fx, kestrel-payments, northwind-custody, orion-prime), each with pipeline.py, dag.py, mapping.yaml and approval.json

rows.label: Sandbox kind
rows.value: subprocess: python -I in a scratch directory with a minimal environment, 17 harness reports

rows.label: Generated code lines
rows.value: 1689 lines across the final pipeline.py, dag.py and mapping.yaml of 6 runs

rows.label: Live provider accuracy
rows.value: bench runs the deterministic fake provider only; Ollama, vLLM, Bedrock and Anthropic backends are not scored offline

rows.label: Docker sandbox
rows.value: harness supports sandbox=docker (python:3.12-slim, --network none); the bench always uses subprocess so its output is identical with or without Docker

rows.label: Airflow real import
rows.value: scripts/airflow_smoke.sh imports deploy/*/dag.py under real Airflow; not run by the offline bench
